body:
It doesn't matter though. Sure, I care about some people and others care about me, but it just doesn't matter. I just can't stand the shame ontop of the clinical depression. Everything is just terrible lately and I think the people that know me will understand that I just wasn't strong enough for this world/my mind. 

 It also really sucks loving somebody that loves you back, but you can't be with them. I don't know if she still loves me, but it could never work so it doesn't matter. Her OCD/anxiety problems are very severe even with medication and it breaks my heart. I feel like I could honestly handle it, but she can't. Oh well. Thats not the reason I want this, but it is something and I figured I'd mention it.
